chunks.title: Add backend Customer 360 API endpoint backed by Snowflake RPT_CUSTOMER_LTV
chunks.description: Create a new FastAPI GET endpoint that queries the Snowflake RPT_CUSTOMER_LTV view and returns Customer 360 data in a frontend-friendly shape. Support optional search/filter parameters for customer name and segment, and include top customers, segment breakdown, booking history events, and loyalty tier distribution in one response payload.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/customers/360 exists and returns JSON from Snowflake RPT_CUSTOMER_LTV
Endpoint accepts query params for customer_name and segment filtering
Response includes top customers, segment breakdown, booking history timeline data, and loyalty tier distribution
Backend handles empty results and Snowflake errors gracefully with appropriate HTTP status codes
API uses existing Snowflake connection/config patterns and does not hardcode credentials

chunks.title: Add Customer 360 page shell and navigation entry
chunks.description: Create a new React page for Customer 360 with the portal's existing visual language, brand colors, and responsive layout. Add a navigation entry in App.jsx so the page is reachable from the portal menu and URL page parameter.
acceptance_criteria: Customer 360 appears in the app navigation and can be opened via page state and URL parameter
Page uses BLUE and GOLD brand colors and matches existing card/table styling
Layout is mobile responsive with stacked sections on small screens
Page renders a header, filter area, and placeholder sections for charts/timeline/table without breaking existing routes

chunks.title: Implement Customer 360 data fetching, search/filter controls, and top customers table
chunks.description: Wire the new page to the backend API using VITE_API_URL, add controlled inputs for customer name and segment filters, and render the top customers by lifetime value in a responsive table/card layout. Include loading, empty, and error states.
acceptance_criteria: Page fetches data from `${import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL}/api/customers/360`
Search/filter inputs update the request and refresh results
Top customers are displayed with lifetime value, segment, loyalty tier, and key summary fields
Loading, error, and no-results states are visible and user-friendly
UI remains usable on mobile with horizontal scrolling or stacked cards as needed

chunks.title: Add segment breakdown pie chart and loyalty tier distribution visualization
chunks.description: Render the segment breakdown as a pie/donut chart and the loyalty tier distribution as a compact chart or segmented summary using lightweight in-app SVG/CSS rendering or an existing chart approach already used in the project. Keep the implementation dependency-minimal and responsive.
acceptance_criteria: Segment breakdown is visualized as a pie/donut chart with labels or legend
Loyalty tier distribution is visualized clearly and matches backend data
Charts resize or reflow appropriately on mobile screens
Colors align with brand palette and maintain sufficient contrast
Charts render correctly for empty and populated datasets

chunks.title: Add booking history timeline and polish responsive Customer 360 interactions
chunks.description: Implement a booking history timeline section for the selected or top customer records, and finalize responsive behavior, accessibility, and interaction details such as selecting a customer row to inspect timeline details.
acceptance_criteria: Booking history is shown as a chronological timeline with date, booking value, and relevant metadata
Selecting a customer updates the timeline/details panel without a full page reload
Timeline is readable on mobile and desktop
Interactive elements have clear focus/hover states and accessible labels
Final page is visually consistent with the rest of the portal and does not regress existing pages
